name: your-inner-fish
title: 你内心的鱼
description: Neil Shubin's Your Inner Fish — a paleontology and evolutionary biology toolkit revealing how the 3.5-billion-year history of life is written in our bodies, from the fish-like structures in our arms to the shark-like nerves in our heads, anchored in the discovery of Tiktaalik, the fossil fish that walked.
